Overview

Depthizo turns your footage into AI-generated depth maps inside DaVinci Resolve. Use grayscale depth for masks and compositing, or explore colored depth gradients for stylized looks.

Processing runs locally using bundled models and runtimes. No external application, Python setup, or additional model download is required. Choose CPU or GPU processing, adjust the depth range, and refine the result with sharpening, smoothness, and optional temporal stability.

Available free from the Clipyx store, with installers for Windows x64 and macOS 14 or newer on Apple Silicon (M1 or newer).

Requirements

Software
DaVinci Resolve Free or Studio (OpenFX plugin)
Operating system
Windows x64, or macOS 14 or newer on Apple Silicon (M1 or newer). Intel Macs are not supported yet.
Processing
Runs locally with bundled models on CPU or GPU; no Python setup or model download
Download
Installers for Windows and macOS on your personal download page

Questions about your setup? Ask in the Clipyx Discord or send us a message.

Key features

  • AI depth estimation directly inside DaVinci Resolve through OpenFX.
  • Offline processing with bundled models and CPU or GPU options.
  • Standard, High, and Ultra quality settings.
  • Near/far range controls, depth inversion, and grayscale depth output.
  • Color gradients with custom endpoints and a Mix control.
  • Sharpening, spatial smoothness, and optional temporal stability.
  • Use Alpha preserves the source clip's transparency.
  • Cached depth results for reuse, with refresh and cache-location controls.

Best for

  • Depth-based masks for grading and compositing
  • Depth-driven atmospheric and visual effects
  • Stylized color-gradient looks
  • Depth visualization for motion graphics workflows
Setup & help guide for Depthizo Install, find it in Resolve, the controls, common problems, uninstall

Depthizo 1.0: Windows 10 (version 1903 or later) or Windows 11, 64-bit, or macOS 14 or later on Apple Silicon. The Mac version does not support Intel / Rosetta Resolve.

Install
  1. Close Resolve and save your project first. On Windows, the installer offers to close Resolve for you.
  2. Windows: run DepthizoInstaller.exe. If “Windows protected your PC” appears, choose More info, then Run anyway, and allow the administrator prompt.
  3. macOS: open DepthizoInstaller-macOS.pkg. If macOS blocks it, open System Settings → Privacy & Security and choose Open Anyway.
  4. The plugin installs to C:\Program Files\Common Files\OFX\Plugins\Depthizo.ofx.bundle on Windows, or to /Library/OFX/Plugins/Depthizo.ofx.bundle on macOS, with its models and runtime; nothing else needs to be downloaded.
  5. An older Depthizo, including one copied in by hand, is moved aside as a backup, so only one stays active. Your projects and cached depth maps are kept.
Where it appears in Resolve

Search Depthizo in Resolve’s Effects / OpenFX list and apply it to your clip. In Fusion, search Depthizo with Shift+Space and connect an image to it. Depth generates on demand as frames render.

Controls in plain words

Some controls appear only after choosing the relevant mode.

Depth and color
Depth Output
Chooses whether nearby objects appear white or black. Switching does not rerun the AI model.
Depth Range Near / Depth Range Far
Remaps the near and far endpoints to isolate the depth range you want.
Mix
Blends the depth look over the source; 0 shows the source. For a full node bypass, use Blend = 0 in Common Controls.
Show Depth
Shows the grayscale depth matte and ignores Mix and Depth Color.
Invert Depth
Flips light and dark in the adjusted map and reverses its color gradient.
Use Alpha
Preserves the source’s transparency, including in Show Depth. Off makes the depth layer opaque.
Depth Color
Chooses grayscale or a color gradient.
Near Hue / Far Hue
Sets the two endpoint hues when Depth Color is Custom.
Smoothness
Blurs small depth variations. Too much can soften useful edges.
Sharpen
Sharpens edges in the depth result.
Temporal Stability
Uses neighboring source frames to reduce flicker. Extra frames can take longer on first use.
Processing and storage
Processing
Chooses CPU or the supported GPU backend: DirectML on Windows, CoreML on Apple Silicon. Try CPU if the GPU cannot run the model.
Quality
Standard, High and Ultra increase the model input resolution. Higher quality is more expensive; changed settings generate their own cached results.
Refresh Depth
Asks Resolve to redraw completed depth results; it does not discard the depth cache.
Start Over
Moves this effect’s generated cache to the Recycle Bin / Trash and clears its memory cache. Frames regenerate when needed.
Cache Location
Chooses a writable cache root. Blank uses your user cache; changing it preserves the old cache. Depthizo manages its own Depthizo-v4 subfolder.
Open Cache Folder
Opens this effect’s generated-cache folder in Explorer or Finder.
Common problems
Missing from Effects
Run the installer again, then restart Resolve. It puts the complete bundle in the OFX Plugins folder and moves any other copy aside.
Mac: Failed to load
Use the native Apple Silicon Resolve on macOS 14 or later. Then tick Depthizo in Resolve → Preferences → System → Video Plugins, Save and restart, even if the old Failed to load label remains.
First frame is slow
The model initializes on first use, and each quality/provider has separate cached results. Let the first frame finish; use Standard while editing.
Colors or Mix do nothing
Turn Show Depth off. For custom endpoint colors, select Custom in Depth Color.
GPU or storage error
Try CPU and a writable Cache Location with free space. Keep the whole bundle together, including models and runtime libraries.
Uninstall
  1. Close Resolve / Fusion. Windows: remove Depthizo in Settings → Apps. macOS: run sudo bash "/Library/Application Support/Clipyx/Depthizo/uninstall.sh" in Terminal.
  2. Generated caches remain separately. Use Open Cache Folder before uninstalling if you want to review them. Removing the plugin alone does not remove your project or cache.

Still stuck? Contact Clipyx with the plugin version, Resolve version, operating system and the exact error message.
